name: SpaceX

eyebrow.en: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. · Class A · Starbase, Texas
eyebrow.zh: SpaceX · A类股 · 德州星港

title.en: Starlink pays the bills, AI now pays too.
title.zh: 星链负责赚钱，AI 也开始赚钱。

lede.en: SpaceX listed in June in the largest IPO ever, raising about $86B at $135 a share. Q3 revenue grew 161% to $14.6B and it turned its first profit as a public company: $2.8B operating income, $4.4B net. The Super Intelligence segment (the former xAI, plus Cursor) is now the biggest business at $7.6B, but capex hit $19.6B and is guided to $35–40B in Q4. Elon Musk holds about 82% of the votes.
lede.zh: SpaceX 于6月以史上最大 IPO 上市，以每股 $135 募资约 860 亿美元。第三季营收增 161% 至 146 亿美元，并实现上市后首次盈利：营业利润 28 亿、净利润 44 亿美元。超级智能板块（原 xAI，加上 Cursor）以 76 亿美元成为最大业务，但资本开支达 196 亿美元，第四季指引 350–400 亿。马斯克持有约 82% 投票权。

s.zh: 2026 第四季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes since the June 12 listing, with the 50-day average. One-year and 200-day figures fill in as history builds.
sub_price.zh: 自6月12日上市以来的每日收盘价与50日均线。一年期与200日数据将随历史累积补齐。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. SpaceX has published quarterly results for Q1–Q3 2026 and the first half of 2025; Q3 2025 revenue and operating loss come from the Q3 2026 release (gross margin not disclosed). Management guides Q1 2027 revenue to $33–37B but gave no Q4 figure.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。SpaceX 已公布 2026 年 Q1–Q3 及 2025 上半年季度业绩；2025 Q3 营收与营业亏损取自 2026 Q3 财报对比数据（未披露毛利率）。管理层指引 2027 年第一季营收 330–370 亿美元，未给出第四季数字。

s.zh: +830% · 营业利润 4.31 亿 · EBITDA 50 亿
同比 +6%、环比 +84% · 营业亏损 700 万
星链，同比 +89% · Q3 新增 160 万（预期 230 万）

p.en: SI revenue tripled QoQ to $7.56B on new cloud deals, Cursor ($608M since Aug 14) and Grok, with $5.0B of EBITDA and $431M operating income ($1.6B before Cursor stock pay). Backlog is $63B, about $42B of it due within a year, and Q1 2027 revenue is guided to $33–37B.
p.zh: 超级智能收入环比增至三倍达 75.6 亿美元，来自新云服务合约、Cursor（8月14日以来 6.08 亿）及 Grok；EBITDA 50 亿，营业利润 4.31 亿（未计 Cursor 股权激励前为 16 亿）。未完成订单 630 亿，其中约 420 亿将于一年内确认；2027 Q1 营收指引 330–370 亿。

p.en: Connectivity revenue rose 69% to $5.25B with $2.37B of operating income, nearly double a year ago. ARPU rose 5% QoQ to $69, enterprise and government grew 91%, and about 12,000 aircraft are contracted.
p.zh: 连接业务收入增 69% 至 52.5 亿美元，营业利润 23.7 亿，约为去年两倍。ARPU 环比增 5% 至 $69，企业与政府业务增 91%，约 1.2 万架飞机已签约。

p.en: Q3 capex was $19.6B, $16.4B of it AI. The CFO guided Q4 to $35–40B, and Musk targets about 3 GW of compute by year-end and at least 10 GW more in 2027. He says new compute pays back in under a year.
p.zh: 第三季资本开支 196 亿美元，其中 AI 164 亿。CFO 指引第四季 350–400 亿；马斯克目标年底算力约 3 GW，2027 年再增至少 10 GW，并称新算力回本不到一年。

p.en: Special committees at SpaceX and Tesla are studying a combination; Musk is recused and no terms are agreed. Musk owns about 42% of SpaceX but controls about 82% of the votes.
p.zh: SpaceX 与特斯拉的特别委员会正在研究合并，马斯克回避，条款尚未达成。马斯克持有 SpaceX 约 42% 股份，但掌握约 82% 投票权。

p.en: Free cash flow was −$10.0B in Q3 and −$35B in the first nine months. Cash and securities fell to $89.9B against $38.8B of debt and leases, and Q4 capex alone could use roughly $25B net. Expect more debt or vendor financing.
p.zh: 第三季自由现金流 −100 亿美元，前九个月 −350 亿。现金及证券降至 899 亿，债务与租赁 388 亿；仅第四季资本开支就可能净耗约 250 亿。预计还需更多债务或供应商融资。

h.zh: 利润率有一次性因素，用户低于预期

p.en: Gross margin of 62% included one-off benefits (Starlink tariff refunds) and the CFO expects Q4 to look more like Q2's 55%. Starlink added 1.6M subscribers vs 2.3M expected. At ~$1.95T the stock trades at about 61× trailing sales.
p.zh: 62% 的毛利率含一次性收益（星链关税退款），CFO 预计第四季更接近第二季的 55%。星链新增 160 万用户，低于 230 万预期。市值约 1.95 万亿美元，约为近12月营收的 61 倍。

p.en: Musk expects to try catching both booster and ship; weekly flights targeted in 1H 2027.
p.zh: 马斯克计划尝试同时回收助推器与飞船；目标 2027 上半年每周一飞。

p.en: CFO says the company is on track for a $100B annualized revenue run rate in December, with 2.5–3 GW of compute.
p.zh: CFO 称公司有望在12月达到 1000 亿美元年化收入，算力 2.5–3 GW。

p.en: Date not yet announced; Q3 was reported on Oct 20. Q1 2027 revenue guided to $33–37B.
p.zh: 日期未公布；第三季财报于10月20日发布。2027 Q1 营收指引 330–370 亿。

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 21, 2026 (Q3 2026 report). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Space Exploration Technologies Corp.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月21日（2026 第三季财报）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Space Exploration Technologies Corp. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions. SpaceX has published quarterly cash flows for the first half of 2025 and Q1–Q3 2026, so there are five reported quarters, not five years. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元。SpaceX 已公布 2025 上半年及 2026 年 Q1–Q3 的季度现金流，因此只有五个已披露季度而非五年。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Operating cash flow jumped to $9.6B in Q3 as compute leasing and Starlink scaled, but capex of $19.6B still left free cash flow at about −$10B. Over the first nine months SpaceX generated $13.1B from operations and spent $48.1B on capex, a gap of about $35B. Cash and securities fell from about $100B to $89.9B.
read.zh: 随算力租赁与星链规模扩大，第三季经营现金流跃升至 96 亿美元，但 196 亿资本开支使自由现金流仍约 −100 亿。前九个月经营现金流 131 亿、资本开支 481 亿，缺口约 350 亿。现金及证券由约 1000 亿降至 899 亿。

read.en: The CFO guided Q4 capex to $35–40B and Musk wants at least 10 GW of new compute in 2027, so the burn gets bigger before it shrinks. I assume operating cash flow climbs with the $63B backlog and Q1 2027 revenue of $33–37B, giving about −$26B in Q4 and −$21–24B a quarter through Q3 2027. That would use roughly all of today's cash in a year, so new debt, leases or vendor financing are likely.
read.zh: CFO 指引第四季资本开支 350–400 亿，马斯克希望 2027 年新增至少 10 GW 算力，烧钱规模会先扩大再收窄。我假设经营现金流随 630 亿未完成订单及 2027 Q1 330–370 亿营收而上升，第四季约 −260 亿，至 2027 Q3 每季约 −210 至 −240 亿。照此一年将用掉几乎全部现有现金，因此很可能需要新债、租赁或供应商融资。

p.en: $16.4B of Q3's $19.6B capex (84%) went to Super Intelligence infrastructure; nameplate compute reached 1.7 GW, targeting 2.5–3 GW by year-end.
p.zh: 第三季 196 亿资本开支中 164 亿（84%）投向超级智能基础设施；算力达 1.7 GW，目标年底 2.5–3 GW。

p.en: Connectivity capex was about $1.5B in Q3 for satellites and ground stations.
p.zh: 第三季连接业务资本开支约 15 亿美元，用于卫星与地面站。

p.en: The remaining ~$1.7B went mostly to Space; the segment was near break-even (−$7M) on 35 launches, including two Starship flights.
p.zh: 其余约 17 亿主要投向航天；该板块在 35 次发射（含两次星舰）下接近盈亏平衡（−700 万）。

p.en: $9.6B in Q3, up from $2.4B in Q2, on $8.8B of adjusted EBITDA.
p.zh: 第三季 96 亿美元，第二季为 24 亿；调整后 EBITDA 88 亿。

p.en: $63B of backlog at Sep 30, including $17.5B of deferred revenue; about $42B is expected within a year.
p.zh: 截至9月30日未完成订单 630 亿，含 175 亿递延收入；约 420 亿预计一年内确认。

p.en: $89.9B of cash and securities and $38.8B of debt and finance leases; the CFO points to investment-grade debt markets and vendor/customer partnerships.
p.zh: 现金及证券 899 亿，债务与融资租赁 388 亿；CFO 提到投资级债市及供应商/客户合作融资。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes new debt, leases or equity and acquisitions. Q3 cash, cash flow and capex are from the Q3 2026 release as reported in coverage.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入新债、租赁、新股及收购。第三季现金、现金流与资本开支取自 2026 Q3 财报相关报道。

extraNote.en: Q4 2025 cash flow was not published separately, so trailing four-quarter totals are not shown.
extraNote.zh: 2025 年第四季现金流未单独公布，因此不显示近四季合计。
